name: subnex-driver
description: SUBNEX: пульт (admin.html) и приложение водителя (index.html). Проверки: npm test.

scripts.check: node --check i18n.js && node --check ops-dispatch-core.js && node --check ops-dispatch.js && node --check ops-chat.js
scripts.i18n:wrap: node _tools/i18n-wrap.mjs ops-dispatch-core.js --write --keys _tools/keys.json && node _tools/i18n-wrap.mjs ops-dispatch.js --write --keys _tools/keys.json && node _tools/i18n-wrap.mjs ops-chat.js --write --keys _tools/keys.json && node _tools/i18n-wrap.mjs admin.html --write --keys _tools/keys.json && node _tools/html-keys.mjs admin.html _tools/keys.json
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:core && npm run test:gs && npm run test:i18n && npm run test:smoke
